title: Turnstile safety lane with snapshot quarantine and synthetic-smoke bridge for incremental ABs
author: Maya Nguyen
description: Context: Teams asked for a lightweight, auditable safety lane to introduce tiny A/B fractions and shadow rehearsals without risking full commit traffic. This PR implements a 'turnstile' safety lane: an opt-in side-path in the rollout runtime that holds traffic in a quarantine snapshot, runs synthetic-smoke rehearsals and an observation-driven gate before any traffic is promoted. Motivation: existing staged rollouts either fully shadow (no live validation) or promote trivially; we needed a middle ground that provides deterministic snapshotting, reproducible replays, and automated backout hooks when smoke or live metrics diverge. High level: 1) snapshot-quarantine: capture deterministic request slice and KV snapshot at rollout start and keep it isolated for replay/smoke; 2) synthetic-smoke-bridge: exercise the candidate model with engineered synthetic prompts representative of targeted cohorts plus a small randomized sampling of live traffic to surface regressions early; 3) incremental-ab-toggle: support fractional AB toggles driven by telemetry confidence rather than fixed timers; 4) auto-backout-agent: automated rollback when metric envelopes exceed configured thresholds or when smoke-run asserts fail. Implementation details: added a new TurnstileController in rollout/orchestrator that coordinates snapshot creation and lease-based quarantine; stores snapshot metadata in /orchestrator/snapshots service; integrates with the existing telemetry scorer to compute a confidence score (weighted latency + reply-coherence + safety-checks). The synthetic-smoke-bridge is implemented as a lightweight harness that can run in parallel to live shadowing; it supports custom smoke sets per-Linear task and records diffs to the smoke ledger. The incremental AB toggle uses a token-fraction allocator that permits deterministic seeding for reproducible experiments. Rollback hooks include an idempotent revert plan that triggers a graceful drain of promoted lanes and promotes an observational rollback snapshot for offline analysis. Testing: unit tests for TurnstileController lease logic and snapshot lifecycle; integration tests that simulate snapshot capture, smoke bridge runs, and automated backout flow; e2e rehearsal on staging with a 0.5% AB using the redwood/bench harness. Performance: isolated smoke runs target sub-10ms wall time per synthetic prompt in the harness; added opt-out feature to bypass smoke bridge for emergency hotfixes. Migration and config: new rolloutPolicy.turnstile object in deployment manifests with fields: snapshotWindowMs, smokeSetRef, initialFraction, confidenceThresholds, maxGraceRevertSecs. Defaults are conservative. Backwards compatibility: feature is opt-in; existing rollouts unchanged. Rollout plan: land behind feature flag rollout.turnstile.enabled; pilot with internal infra and one customer on Dedicated for two weeks; monitor the telemetry confidence trace and SLO alerts. Related Linear: ENG-12890 (turnstile design), ENG-12912 (smoke bridge harness), PM-457 (customer pilot).
